title: All about me
goal: Talk about yourself and your typical day in the Present Simple — and one person in your family with he / she + -s.
warmup: What is your name, and how old are you?
Where do you live? Do you like your town?
What is your favourite subject at school? Why?

main.task: Describe your typical weekday from morning to night.
main.howto: One or two minutes. Use at least five routine phrases, two times of day and two adverbs of frequency. Short sentences are fine.
prompts: What time do you usually wake up? Do you get up straight away?
What do you have for breakfast?
How do you get to school? What time do lessons finish?
What do you do after school?
What time do you usually go to bed?

followup: What do you like most about your day?
What is different at the weekend?
Tell me about one person in your family: what does he or she do every day?
teacher: Не виправляй під час розповіді — запиши 3–4 помилки (особливо he/she без -s і I am + verb) і розбери їх наприкінці. Це вхідний урок: головне, щоб вона говорила, навіть короткими реченнями.

title: People in my life
goal: Describe a person's appearance and character, say what they usually do and what they are doing in a photo.
warmup: Who do you look like in your family?
Who do you get on with best? Why?
Are you more shy or more talkative?

main.task: Show or describe a photo of someone in your family or a friend.
main.howto: One or two minutes. Two words for appearance, two for character, one sentence about their routine (Present Simple) and two about the photo (Present Continuous).
prompts: Who is this? How old is he / she?
What does he / she look like?
What is he / she like?
What does he / she usually do at the weekend?
Where are they in the photo? What are they doing? What is he / she wearing?

phrases: He / She has long / short, curly / straight … hair.
He / She is very… but a bit…
In this photo he / she is …-ing
I take after… / I look like…
followup: Who do you take after — your mum or your dad?
What is your best friend doing right now, do you think?
Describe your English teacher in three words!
teacher: Слухай дві речі: чи не губить is/are у Continuous (she reading) і чи не ставить Continuous на звички (she is going every day). Запиши 3–4 помилки, розбери в кінці. Якщо фото немає — опис по памʼяті.

title: Usually — but this week…
goal: Talk about your usual life and about this week in pairs of sentences: Present Simple for habits, Present Continuous for now, temporary situations and plans.
warmup: What do you usually do on Friday evenings?
What are you doing this weekend?
Which subject are you revising at the moment?

main.task: Compare your usual week with this week.
main.howto: Two minutes. Every idea in a pair: «I usually…, but this week I'm…». At least one plan for the weekend and one thing that is getting better.
prompts: What time do you usually get up? Are you getting up earlier these days?
Which subject do you like most? What are you studying now?
What do you usually do in the evening? What are you watching or reading these days?
What are you doing this weekend?
What is getting better in your English?

phrases: I usually…, but this week I'm…
followup: What do you do? vs What are you doing? — answer both!
What is changing in your town or village?
What does your best friend usually do at the weekend? And this weekend?
teacher: Слухай два типи помилок: Continuous на звичку (she is going every day) і Simple на «зараз / цього тижня». Не перебивай — запиши 3–4 речення і в кінці попроси її саму пояснити, чому той чи інший час (за алгоритмом із вкладки Grammar).

title: My last weekend
goal: Tell the story of your last weekend in the Past Simple and compare it with what you usually do.
warmup: What did you have for breakfast today?
What time did you go to bed yesterday?
Where were you on Sunday afternoon?

main.task: Tell your teacher about your last weekend.
main.howto: One or two minutes, in time order: Saturday morning → evening → Sunday. At least five verbs in the Past Simple and one sentence with was / were.
prompts: What time did you get up on Saturday?
What did you do in the afternoon?
Did you go out or stay in?
Who did you meet up with?
What was the best moment of the weekend?

phrases: Usually I…, but last weekend I…
followup: What do you usually do at the weekend?
What are you doing next weekend?
What did you do last summer?
teacher: Слухай три речі: неправильні дієслова (goed, buyed), форму після didn't (didn't went) і чи не зісковзує в Present (Yesterday I go). Запиши 3–4 речення і в кінці попроси її саму виправити.
